item.name: paypal_create_invoice
item.description: Create and send a draft invoice to a customer email address.

amount.description: Total amount to invoice in USD

note.description: Optional invoice terms or line items

item.name: paypal_get_invoice_details
item.description: Fetch status, timestamps, and balance for a specific invoice ID.

invoice_id.description: Unique identifier of the invoice (e.g., INV-2026-0049)

item.name: paypal_cancel_invoice
item.description: Cancel a sent or unpaid invoice and notify the recipient.

invoice_id.description: Unique identifier of the invoice to cancel

item.name: paypal_send_invoice_reminder
item.description: Send an automated payment reminder for an unpaid or past-due invoice.

invoice_id.description: Invoice ID to send reminder for

item.name: paypal_check_dispute
item.description: Retrieve open or resolved dispute status, claims, and seller actions.

item.name: paypal_escalate_dispute
item.description: Escalate an existing buyer-seller inquiry into an official PayPal claim.

item.name: paypal_provide_dispute_evidence
item.description: Submit tracking numbers or documentation evidence for an active dispute.

item.name: paypal_get_sales_volume
item.description: Retrieve transaction count, net revenue, and aggregate sales for a given date range.

item.name: paypal_create_order
item.description: Initialize a checkout order with intent to capture or authorize funds.

item.name: paypal_capture_order
item.description: Capture payment for an approved order to finalize the transaction.

order_id.description: Order ID returned during checkout initialization

item.name: paypal_issue_refund
item.description: Issue a full or partial refund for an existing captured payment.

item.name: paypal_create_subscription_plan
item.description: Define billing cycles, trial intervals, and recurring fees for subscriptions.

item.name: paypal_cancel_subscription
item.description: Terminate an active recurring subscription agreement.

item.name: paypal_create_payout
item.description: Disburse batch or individual payments directly to vendor or contractor accounts.

item.name: paypal_list_webhooks
item.description: List all configured webhooks receiving asynchronous event updates.
